blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: 3D-aware representations can improve robotic manipulation by providing geometric information that is robust to changes in viewpoint, object position, and occlusion. However, using 3D inputs at deployment requires additional sensing and processing, making image-based policies more practical. We ask whether an image-based policy can acquire 3D shape information during training while retaining a purely image-based interface at deployment. We propose shape-teacher alignment, a training-time mechanism that uses a pretrained 3D shape representation as an alignment target for an image-based policy encoder. Specifically, we use Point-MAE features from individual objects as targets for corresponding image patches, transferring geometric structure to the policy without changing its deployment inputs or architecture. On LIBERO, shape-teacher alignment produces image representations that are more structured around object shape and corresponding parts, while substantially accelerating policy convergence and improving success rates. For pretrained policies, convergence is accelerated by 4.7x and 5.6x on the Object and Spatial suites, respectively, without requiring the shape teacher or depth input at deployment.
blocks.zh: 3D-意识的表示方式可以通过提供几何信息来改进机器人的操纵,这些几何信息对于观点、物体位置和隐蔽性的变化是强有力的。 然而,在部署时使用三维输入需要额外的感知和处理,使基于图像的政策更加实用. 我们询问,基于图像的政策能否在培训期间获取三维形状信息,同时在部署时保留纯粹基于图像的界面。 我们提议进行形状-教师调整,这是一种培训时间机制,利用预先训练过的3D形状代表作为图像政策编码器的调整目标。 具体来说,我们使用单个对象的Point-MAE特性作为相应的图像补丁的目标,在不改变其部署输入或架构的情况下将几何结构转移给策略. 在LIBERO上,形状-教师对齐产生更围绕对象形状和相应部分结构的图像表现,同时大幅加快政策趋同,提高成功率. 对于经过预先训练的政策,在对象套房和空间套房上分别以4.7x和5.6x加速趋同,在部署时不需要形状老师或深度输入.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Geometric information is important for robotic manipulation, with 3D-aware policies demonstrating improved data efficiency and robustness to variations such as viewpoint changes, object displacement, and occlusion ( Zhen et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Qu et al., 2025 ; Ze et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . However, incorporating 3D observations into a robotic policy requires additional sensing and processing, including depth cameras, calibration, and depth estimation. These costs make purely image-based policies attractive in practice, but such policies can lack the geometric information needed for robust manipulation ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Garcia et al., 2025 ) . We therefore ask: can a 2D robotic policy acquire shape-aware representations during training without requiring 3D inputs at deployment?
blocks.zh: 几何信息对于机器人操纵很重要,3D-意识政策表明,数据效率得到提高,对观点变化、物体迁移和隔离等变化具有强烈性(Zhen等,2024;Sun等,2025;Li等,2026a; Qu等,2025;Ze等,2024;Chen等,2023.). 然而,将三维观测纳入机器人政策需要更多的遥感和处理,包括深度相机、校正和深度估计。 这些费用使纯粹基于形象的政策在实践中具有吸引力,但这些政策可能缺乏有力操纵所需的几何信息(Sun等,2025;Garcia等,2025)。 因此,我们问:2D机器人政策能否在培训过程中获得体会到形状的表述,而不在部署时需要3D投入?

blocks.en: Recent work on diffusion models has shown that pretrained representations can guide a target model through Representation Alignment (REPA). REPA ( Yu et al., 2025 ) aligns intermediate representations with features from a frozen pretrained encoder, improving convergence and generation quality, and has since been applied to robotic policies using pretrained vision encoders as alignment targets ( Li et al., 2025 ; Qiu et al., 2026 ) . However, these approaches do not specifically target 3D geometric structure, leaving open whether alignment with a representation that explicitly captures 3D shape can introduce geometric structure into an image-based policy. A shape teacher can encourage the policy encoder to represent corresponding geometric structure across objects, while the policy itself remains image-based at deployment.
blocks.zh: 最近关于传播模式的研究表明,经过预先培训的表述可以通过表述对等(REPA)指导目标模型. REPA(Yu等,2025年)将中间表示与冷冻预装编码器的特征相配合,提高了聚合和生成质量,并自此被应用于机器人政策中,将预装的视觉编码器作为配对目标(Li等,2025年;Quu等,2026年). 然而,这些方法并没有专门针对3D几何结构,因此,与明确能捕捉到3D形状的表示式的对接能否将几何结构引入以图像为基础的政策中留有余地. 形状老师可以鼓励策略编码器代表相应的跨对象几何结构,而策略本身在部署时仍然是以图像为基础的.

blocks.en: We use a pretrained 3D shape teacher, Point-MAE ( Pang et al., 2022 ) , to align the image encoder of a 2D diffusion policy during training. Point-MAE features from individual objects are aligned with their corresponding image patches, encouraging the policy encoder to incorporate geometric structure while retaining the original image-based policy interface. We evaluate the resulting representations and policies on LIBERO, finding that shape-teacher alignment produces image representations that are more structured around object shape and corresponding object parts, while the resulting policies converge substantially faster and achieve higher success rates. For pretrained policies, convergence is accelerated by 4.7 × \times and 5.6 × \times on the Object and Spatial suites, respectively, with no need for the shape teacher or depth input at deployment. A comparison with a semantic teacher shows that shape and semantic alignment induce different representations, demonstrating that alignment can be used to impose distinct structural biases on the policy encoder.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个经过预先训练的3D外形教师Point-MAE(Pang等,2022年),在训练期间将2D传播政策的图像编码器对接. 来自单个对象的点-MAE特征与其相适应的图像补丁一致,鼓励策略编码器在保留以图像为基础的原始政策界面的同时纳入几何结构. 我们评价由此产生的关于LIBERO的表述和政策,发现形状-教师对齐产生更围绕对象形状和相应对象部分结构的图像表述,而由此产生的政策则大大地更快地趋同并取得更高的成功率. 对于经过预先训练的政策,在对象套房和空间套房上分别加速了4.7分相和5.6分相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相相和相和相和相相相相和相相和相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 与语义老师的比较表明,形状和语义相接会诱发不同的表述,表明相接可以用来将明显的结构偏差强加给政策编码器.

blocks.en: To summarize, we make the following contributions:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们作出以下贡献:

blocks.en: • We introduce shape-teacher alignment, a training-time mechanism for transferring 3D shape structure into an image-based robotic policy encoder without requiring 3D inputs at deployment. • We instantiate shape-teacher alignment by matching per-object features from a pretrained 3D shape encoder to corresponding image patches, while keeping the deployed policy unchanged. • On LIBERO, shape-teacher alignment produces more shape-structured representations and substantially faster policy convergence, with 4.7 × \times and 5.6 × \times speedups for pretrained policies on the Object and Spatial suites, respectively.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们引入了形状-教师对接机制,这是一种将3D形状结构转换成基于图像的机器人政策编码器而无需在部署时提供3D投入的培训时间机制。 我们通过将预先训练的3D形状编码器的每个对象特征相匹配到相应的图像补丁来即时调整形状-老师的对齐,同时保持所部署的策略不变. ^ 在LIBERO上,外形-师资相接能产生更外形结构化的表示并大大加快政策趋同,对象套房和空间套房的预训政策分别有4.7×分时和5.6×分时速.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: We use the diffusion policy of Chi et al. (2025) as our behavioral cloning baseline. The policy conditions on two consecutive observations, t − 1 t-1 and t t , and predicts a 10-step action trajectory, of which 8 steps are executed. We keep the action diffusion process unchanged, while modifying the observation encoder and transformer decoder. The observation encoder is a ViT/S-14 with the same architectural modifications as DINOv2: the CLS token is discarded, and the remaining patch tokens are used as observation features. The language token is produced by a frozen CLIP language model ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , and the diffusion timestep is encoded using a sinusoidal embedding. The transformer decoder follows the cross-attention architecture of Chi et al. (2025) and consists of a 12-layer decoder and a 2-layer encoder for the conditioning tokens. Inspired by Dasari et al. (2025) , the output projections of the cross-attention blocks are zero-initialized to improve stability.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Chi等人(2025年)的传播政策作为我们的行为克隆基线. 连续两次观测的政策条件为t-1t-1和tt,并预测了10步动作轨迹,其中8步被执行. 我们保持动作扩散过程不变,同时修改观测编码器和变压器解码器. 观测编码器为ViT/S-14,与DINOv2相同的建筑修改:CLS符号被丢弃,所剩的补丁符号被作为观测特征. 语言符由被冻结的CLIP语言模型(Radford等,2021年)出产,并使用sinusoidal嵌入来编码扩散时间步. 变压器解码器遵循了Chi等(2025年)的交叉意向架构,由12层的解码器和2层的调节符组成. 在Dasari等(2025年)的启发下,相向块的输出预测为零初始化,以提高稳定性.

blocks.en: We align image-patch representations with features from a frozen pretrained 3D shape encoder. We use Point-MAE ( Pang et al., 2022 ) as the shape teacher, which encodes individual 3D objects into local shape features. For each object, we construct a point cloud from its mask and depth map, resample it to 1024 points, and partition the points into local groups of M = 32 M=32 points. Point-MAE then produces a feature for each group.
blocks.zh: 我们用冷冻的前置3D外形编码器的特征来调整图像平面表示。 我们使用Point-MAE(Pang等,2022年)作为外形老师,将单个3D物体编码为局部外形特征. 对于每个物体,我们从它的面具和深度图中构造出一个点云,将它重新做成1024个点,并将点分为M=32个M=32个点的局部组. 然后点-MAE为每个组产生一个特性.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate whether shape-teacher alignment changes the learned image representations and improves policy learning, while preserving the image-only deployment interface. We consider two common regimes for robotic policy learning: training a task-specific policy from scratch on the target tasks, and fine-tuning a policy from a pretrained checkpoint. This allows us to evaluate shape-teacher alignment both when the policy learns its visual representation from scratch and when it starts from an existing pretrained representation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价形状-教师对接是否改变学到的图像表达方式并改进政策学习,同时保留只使用图像的部署界面。 我们认为机器人政策学习的两个共同制度:从零开始对目标任务进行具体任务政策培训,从经过预先训练的检查站调整政策。 这使我们能够在政策从零开始学习其视觉表现以及从现有的预先训练过的描述开始评价形状-教师调整。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Patch similarity visualization. The red square marks the query patch and the green square its most similar patch.
blocks.zh: 图1:补丁相似可视化. 红色正方形标志了查询补丁和绿色正方形最相近的补丁.

blocks.en: We conduct all experiments on the LIBERO benchmark ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , using the LIBERO-Object and LIBERO-Spatial suites. For experiments with pretrained policies, we use LIBERO-90 to pretrain the policy. To evaluate robustness to changes in object placement, we use Object-Displacement and Spatial-Displacement datasets constructed by placing targets on two rings around their original locations (Figure 9 ). We additionally evaluate zero-shot robustness to occlusion using LIBERO-Occ ( Li et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 我们使用LIBERO-Object和LIBERO-空间套房进行LIBERO基准(Liu等人,2023年)的所有实验。 对于预训政策实验,我们使用LIBERO-90预训政策. 为了评估物体放置变化的稳健性,我们使用通过在原位置周围的两个环上放置目标而构建的物体放置和空间放置数据集(图9)。 我们还利用LIBERO-Occ(Li等,2026b.),对零射强性进行隔离评估。

blocks.en: We evaluate whether shape-teacher alignment changes the structure of the learned image representations and improves downstream policy learning. We examine whether aligned features are organized more strongly by object identity, object category, shape, and corresponding object parts. Policy performance is measured by task success rate throughout training, allowing us to compare both final performance and convergence speed. For robustness experiments, we measure the change in success rate relative to the standard evaluation setting under target displacement and occlusion.
blocks.zh: 我们评价形状-教师的调整是否改变了学到的形象表述结构,并改善下游的政策学习。 我们检查对齐的特征是否按照对象身份,对象类别,形状,以及相应的对象部分组织得更强烈. 衡量政策业绩的标准是整个培训中任务的成功率,使我们能够比较最终业绩和汇合速度。 对于稳健性实验,我们衡量成功率相对于目标迁移和隔离下标准评价设定的变化。

blocks.en: We compare shape-teacher alignment against the corresponding no-alignment diffusion policy in both training regimes. In the from pretrained setting, the policy is initialized from a checkpoint trained on LIBERO-90 and then fine-tuned on the target tasks. In the from scratch setting, the same architecture is trained from random initialization on the target tasks. Unless otherwise stated, the aligned model uses Point-MAE as the shape teacher with alignment weight λ = 3 \lambda=3 .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了形状教师与两个培训制度中相应的不调整传播政策。 在经过预先训练的情况下,政策从一个经过LIBERO-90训练的检查站起步,然后对目标任务进行微调。 在从零开始的设置中,同一架构通过随机初始化对目标任务进行训练. 除非另有说明,对接模式使用点-MAE作为有对接重量=Q=3\lambda=3的形状老师.

blocks.en: 3.1 Shape- and Object-centric Representation
blocks.zh: 3.1 以形状和物体为中心的代表

blocks.en: We examine whether shape-teacher alignment transfers geometric structure into the image encoder, using patch-level similarity to assess correspondence across object parts and object-level clustering to assess object structure.
blocks.zh: 我们研究形状-老师对接是否将几何结构转移入图像编码器,使用补丁级相似度来评估对象部分之间的对应关系和对象级集群来评估对象结构.

blocks.en: We first examine whether image patches representing similar object parts and shapes become more similar after alignment. For each selected patch, we identify the most similar patch among the image features and record whether it corresponds to the same object, another object with similar shape, or an unrelated region. Table 1 shows the resulting distribution on LIBERO-Object. For pretrained policies, alignment with the shape teacher increases the fraction of matches to another similar-shape object from 8.2% to 35.1%, while the fraction of matches falling into the “unrelated” category decreases from 81.6% to 56.0%. The same trend is observed for policies trained from scratch, where similar-shape matches increase from 10.7% to 36.4%. Figure 1 provides qualitative examples of these matches: aligned features can match corresponding parts across similarly shaped objects, such as the neck of a bottle or the side of a bowl, rather than only nearby patches of the same object. These results indicate that alignment introduces shape-related structure into the patch representations.
blocks.zh: 我们首先检查代表类似对象部件和形状的图像补丁是否在对齐后变得更加相似. 对于每一个所选的补丁,我们都会在图像特征中识别出最相近的补丁并记录它是否对应同一个对象,另一个形状相近的对象,或者一个无关的区域. 表1显示LIBERO-Object的分布情况。 就预先训练的政策而言,与外形师的配合将匹配到另一个类似外形物体的比例从8.2%增加到35.1%,而属于“无关”类别的匹配比例从81.6%减少到56.0%。 从零开始培训的政策也呈现出同样的趋势,类似的匹配率从10.7%上升到36.4%。 图1提供了这些匹配的定性实例:对齐特征可以匹配相近形状物体上的相应部分,如瓶子的颈部或碗边,而不只是同一物体的相邻补丁. 这些结果表明,对接将与形状相关的结构引入了补丁表示.

blocks.en: We next examine whether alignment also organizes representations at the object level. We average the patch features corresponding to each object and visualize the resulting representations with t-SNE in Figure 2 . Compared with the baseline, the aligned representations form clearer clusters of objects, indicating that alignment also produces stronger object-level structure. Together with the patch-level analysis above, this suggests that shape-teacher alignment organizes the image representation both across corresponding object parts and at the level of whole objects.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来审查是否也组织物体一级的表示。 我们平均对应每个对象的补丁特性,并在图2中以t-SNE可视化所得出的表示. 与基线相比,对齐的表示构成更清晰的对象集群,表明对齐还会产生更强的对象级结构. 与上面的补丁级分析一起,这说明形状-老师对齐既将图像表现组织在相应的对象部分之间,也组织在整体对象的层次上.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Policy learning with and without shape-teacher alignment across LIBERO-Object and LIBERO-Spatial, for pretrained and from-scratch policies. Shape-teacher alignment accelerates convergence in both training regimes. Shaded regions show ± 1 \pm 1 standard deviation over three seeds.
blocks.zh: 图3:无论有无形状师资协调,在LIBERO-Object和LIBERO-Spaceal之间开展政策学习,用于预训和从课外政策。 形而上学的教师协调加快了两种培训制度的趋同。 阴影区域显示±1\pm 1标准偏差超过3个种子.

blocks.en: 3.2 Improved Convergence
blocks.zh: 3.2 改进聚合

blocks.en: We next examine whether the representational changes induced by shape-teacher alignment translate into faster policy learning. Figure 3 compares the success rate throughout training for the baseline and Point-MAE-aligned policies in both training regimes. For pretrained policies, alignment reaches the same success rate as the baseline 4.7 × \times faster on LIBERO-Object and 5.6 × \times faster on LIBERO-Spatial. The effect is also present when training from scratch, with convergence accelerated by 2.3 × \times and 3.9 × \times on the Object and Spatial suites, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来要审查的是,由形而上学-教师调整引起的代表性变化是否转化为更快的政策学习。 图3比较了两个培训体制中基线政策与Point-MAE协调政策的整个培训成功率。 对于经过预先训练的政策,调整达到与基线4.7×\时间在LIBERO-Object上更快和5.6×\时间在LIBERO-空间上更快相同的成功率. 从零开始培训时也会产生这种效果,在物体套房和空间套房上分别加速了2.3xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

blocks.en: The consistent acceleration across both training regimes shows that the shape-teacher objective improves the optimization trajectory of the policy rather than only changing its final representation. The larger gains for pretrained policies suggest that shape-teacher alignment is particularly effective when adapting an existing visual representation to the target manipulation tasks.
blocks.zh: 两种培训制度一致加速,表明造型教师目标改进了政策的优化轨迹,而不仅仅是改变其最终代表性。 预先培训后的政策的更大收益表明,在使现有的视觉表现适应目标操纵任务时,形状教师的组合特别有效。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Zero-shot robustness to target occlusion and displacement for the pretrained policies. Annotations show the relative change in success rate from standard evaluation. Error bars show ± 1 \pm 1 standard deviation over three seeds.
blocks.zh: 图4:为预训政策确定隔离和流离失所目标的零射力。 说明显示标准评价成功率的相对变化。 出错栏显示 ± 1\pm 1 标准偏差超过 三种子 。

blocks.en: 3.3 Robustness
blocks.zh: 3.3 强性

blocks.en: We next examine whether the representational changes induced by shape-teacher alignment improve robustness to changes in the deployment environment. We evaluate performance under target displacement and object occlusion by measuring the change in success rate relative to the standard evaluation setting. Figure 4 shows that the effect of alignment depends on both the type of distribution shift and the task suite. Under occlusion, the aligned policy has a similar performance drop to the baseline on LIBERO-Object but a smaller drop on LIBERO-Spatial. Under target displacement, alignment reduces the performance drop on LIBERO-Object, while the difference on LIBERO-Spatial is smaller. Thus, shape-teacher alignment does not provide a uniform improvement in robustness across all distribution shifts, although it performs similarly or better than the baseline across the tested conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来审查由形状-教师调整引起的代表性变化是否使部署环境的变化更加有力。 我们通过衡量成功率相对于标准评价设定的变化,对目标迁移和对象隔离方面的业绩进行评估。 图4显示,调整的效果既取决于分配转移的类型,也取决于任务套件. 在隔离下,调整后的政策的性能下降与LIBERO-Object的基线相类似,但LIBERO-Spatial的下降幅度较小. 在目标位移下,对接会减少LIBERO-Object的性能下降,而LIBERO-Spatial的相差较小. 因此,形而上学的师资协调并不能统一改善所有分配班次的稳健性,尽管它的表现类似或优于测试条件的基线。

blocks.en: 3.4 Alignment Target Ablation
blocks.zh: 3.4 对齐目标

blocks.en: We finally examine whether the structure learned by the policy encoder depends on the choice of alignment target. We replace the Point-MAE shape teacher with DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) , a pretrained semantic vision encoder, while keeping the alignment procedure and policy architecture unchanged. DINOv2-based runs use an alignment weight of λ = 1 \lambda=1 . Table 2 compares the resulting policy performance and convergence speed. DINOv2 provides a strong alignment target and achieves higher success rates in several settings, while Point-MAE remains competitive on pretrained policies.
blocks.zh: 我们最终审查政策编码器所学到的结构是否取决于对齐目标的选择. 我们用DINOv2(Oquab等,2024年)取代了Point-MAE外形教师,这是一个经过预先训练的语义视觉编码器,同时使校正程序和政策架构保持不变. 基于 DINov2 的运行使用 QQ = 1\lambda = 1 的对齐权重. 表2比较了由此产生的政策业绩和趋同速度。 DINOv2提供了很强的对接目标,并在多个场合取得了更高的成功率,而Point-MAE仍然在经过预先训练的政策上具有竞争力.

blocks.en: More importantly, the two alignment targets produce qualitatively different representation structures. Figure 5 shows patch-level similarity for the two aligned encoders. DINOv2 produces more semantic-oriented similarity patterns, whereas Point-MAE produces greater similarity across similarly shaped objects and corresponding object parts. Thus, the effect of alignment is not determined only by the alignment procedure itself: the choice of teacher influences the structural bias learned by the policy encoder.
blocks.zh: 更重要的是,两个调整目标产生了质量不同的代表结构。 图5显示了两个对齐编码器的补丁级相似性. DINOv2产生更注重语义的相似性模式,而Point-MAE则在类似形状的物体和相应的物体部分之间产生更相似性. 因此,校正的效果不仅仅取决于校正程序本身:教师的选择会影响政策编码器所学到的结构偏好.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Success rate at epoch 100 and convergence speed-up for alignment with PointMAE and DINOv2. Convergence speed-up is measured relative to the corresponding no-alignment baseline. Standard deviation over three seeds are reported for Baseline and PointMAE alignment.
blocks.zh: 表2:100世纪成功率和与PointMAE和DINOv2对接的汇合速度。 相接速度比对相应的无对接基线进行测量. 关于基线和点MAE调整,报告标准偏离了三个种子。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Patch-level similarity after alignment with DINOv2 and PointMAE. DINOv2 produces more object-oriented similarity patterns, whereas PointMAE produces greater similarity across corresponding parts of similarly shaped objects.
blocks.zh: 图5:与DINOv2和PointMAE对接后,补丁级相似. DINOv2 生成更面向对象的相似性模式, 而点 MAE在类似形状物体的相应部分产生更大的相似性.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We introduced shape-teacher alignment as a training-time mechanism for transferring 3D shape structure into an image-based robotic policy without requiring 3D inputs at deployment. On LIBERO, alignment produces image representations that are structured around both object shape and object identity, and substantially accelerates policy convergence, with the largest gains observed for policies initialized from pretrained checkpoints. Robustness to distribution shifts is more conditional, varying across perturbation types and task suites. Comparisons with a semantic teacher further show that the choice of alignment target determines the structure induced in the policy representation. These results suggest that representation alignment can be used not only to improve policy optimization, but also to deliberately shape the geometric structure learned by an image-based robotic policy while preserving its deployment interface.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了形状-教师对接,作为将3D形状结构转变为基于图像的机器人政策而不在部署时要求3D投入的培训时间机制. 在LIBERO上,调整生成的图像表现形式结构是围绕对象形状和对象身份的,大大地加快了政策趋同,从经过预先训练的检查站初始化的政策取得了最大的收益。 对分配班次的稳健性比较有条件,因扰动类型和任务套房而异. 与语义老师的比较进一步表明,对齐目标的选择决定了政策表述中诱导的结构. 这些结果表明,代表性的调整不仅可以用来改进政策优化,还可以在保留其部署界面的同时,有意地塑造由基于图像的机器人政策所学到的几何结构.

blocks.en: Our evaluation is limited to a single policy architecture and the LIBERO benchmark, and uses Point-MAE as a single 3D shape teacher. The effect of shape-teacher alignment across other policy architectures, robotic manipulation benchmarks, and pretrained 3D representations therefore remains to be established. The robustness experiments also show that alignment does not uniformly improve performance under all distribution shifts. Future work will investigate whether stronger or more diverse 3D teachers, including representations that combine geometric and semantic information, can transfer complementary structure to the policy encoder, and whether alignment can improve robustness under more challenging forms of occlusion and distribution shift. Extending the evaluation to additional architectures and real-robot settings will further clarify the generality of training-time geometric alignment.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价仅限于单一的政策架构和LIBERO基准,使用Point-MAE作为单一的3D外形教师. 因此,形状教师与其他政策结构、机器人操纵基准以及经过预先培训的3D表述保持一致的影响仍有待确定。 稳健性实验还显示,在所有分配班次下,相接性能并没有统一改善. 今后的工作将调查更强或更多样化的三维教师,包括将几何和语义信息结合起来的表述,是否能够将互补结构转移至政策编码器,以及协调能否在更具挑战性的隔离和分配转移形式下提高稳健性。 将评价范围扩大到其他结构和实际机器人设置,将进一步澄清培训时间几何校正的一般性。

blocks.en: For the shape grouping experiment, similar patches are grouped based on the object mask they land on. See Table 3 for the clustering groups. To get the final result, per encoded image, we select all patches that overlap by at least 50% with object masks in Table 3 . For each of these patches in the object, the most similar patch in terms of cosine similarity is selected. Examples of this can be found in Figure 1 and in Figure 5 . We record whether this patch is inside the same object instance, inside an object within the same group (see Table 3 ), or somewhere else in the image. We average these results over 1000 images to get the final results shown in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 对于形状分组实验,类似的补丁根据它们所降落的物体口罩进行分组. 分组小组见表3。 为了获得最终结果,每个被编码的图像,我们选择所有与表3中的对象口罩重叠至少50%的补丁. 对于对象中的每一个这些补丁,选择了最相近的同位素相似性的补丁. 这方面的例子见图1和图5。 我们记录此补丁是否在同一对象实例内,在同一组内的一个对象内(见表3),或者图像中的其他地方。 我们平均这些结果超过1000个图像,以获得表1显示的最后结果。

blocks.en: In addition to testing the effect of alignment for a fixed alignment weight, we also examined the effect of different alignment weights λ \lambda on the model’s convergence speed. The results for the from-scratch and pre-trained models can be found in Figure 7 . These results suggest that the alignment weight λ \lambda has a sweet spot, and that exceeding it can hurt performance, especially when training from scratch, as shown on the LIBERO-Object set. However, the convergence results differ greatly per configuration. For instance, on the pre-trained models, a higher alignment weight does not seem to strongly affect convergence, nor does it clearly degrade convergence. Still, more configurations and more seeds are needed before we can draw a clear conclusion from these results.
blocks.zh: 除了测试调和对固定调和重量的影响外,我们还考察了不同调和重量QQ\lambda对模型的调和速度的影响. 摘取和预训模型的结果见图7。 这些结果表明,相配重量QQ\lambda有一个甜点,超过它会伤害性能,特别是从零开始训练时,如LIBERO-Object集所显示. 然而,每个组合的趋同结果大相径庭。 例如,在经过预先培训的模型中,较高的对接权重似乎不会严重影响趋同,也不会明显地降低趋同。 然而,在我们能够从这些结果中得出明确结论之前,还需要更多的配置和更多的种子。

blocks.en: We additionally compared PointMAE alignment against DINOv2 alignment for convergence speed, shown in Figure 8 , and for quantitative patch similarity, shown in Table 4 . For convergence speed, our findings are similar to those discussed in Section C : there appears to be an optimum value for the alignment weight, after which convergence speed drops or stays similar, depending on the dataset and on the pre-training. When considering the shape groupings of DINOv2, our findings again are similar to those in Section 3.4 . Where Point-MAE aligned models group patches with similar shapes, more so than patches within the same object, DINOv2 aligned models often select patches from the same object, rather than patches with the same shape. Overall, the fraction of patches whose most similar patch is on an unrelated item is similar for both models.
blocks.zh: 我们还比较了PointMAE和DINOv2的对接,如图8所示,对接速度和量化补丁相似性,如表4所示。 关于趋同速度,我们的调查结果与C节所讨论的结果相似:趋同重量似乎有最佳价值,此后趋同速度下降或保持不变,这取决于数据集和预训。 在考虑DINOv2的形状分组时,我们的调查结果再次与第3.4节中的结论相类似。 当Point-MAE对齐的模型组补丁形状相近,比同对象内部的补丁还要多时,DINOv2对齐的模型经常从同对象中选择补丁,而不是同形状的补丁. 总体而言,最相近的补丁在一个不相干的项目上的比例对于两种模型来说都是相近的.

blocks.en: The out-of-distribution placements of the rings are shown in Figure 9(a) and in Figure 9(b) for LIBERO-Object displacements and LIBERO-Spatial displacements, respectively. To generate the rings, first, the object bounding box over the original dataset target displacements is computed. To generate LIBERO-Spatial displacements, outlier filtering was performed to generate the bounding box, as the spread is much larger than for LIBERO-Object. Not filtering out outliers caused performance on the outermost rings to drop to near zero. The Local Outlier Factor [ Breunig et al., 2000 ] was used to identify outliers. From the bounding box, the rings are computed as fractions of the diameter of the bounding box. Ring 1 starts at 0.1 ⋅ diameter 0.1\cdot\text{diameter} from the edge and ends at 0.25 ⋅ diameter 0.25\cdot\text{diameter} . Ring 2 starts at 0.35 ⋅ diameter 0.35\cdot\text{diameter} from the edge and ends at 0.50 ⋅ diameter 0.50\cdot\text{diameter} . After the areas were created, 15 points were sampled from these areas using rejection sampling.

blocks.en: Appendix F Compute
blocks.zh: 附录 F 计算

blocks.en: All experiments were run on the <redacted for anonymity> compute cluster. All experiments were run on an A100 GPU. Each training run took about 5 hours, and each checkpoint validation took about 15 minutes, for both standard and out-of-distribution validation. Experiments that only used the image encoder, such as patch similarities and t-SNE clustering, were negligible in compute, with each task taking less than 10 minutes. In total, training and evaluating the Point-MAE models, baseline models, and DINOv2 models used in the main paper, as well as the other experiments in the main paper, took around 150 hours on an A100 GPU. The hyperparameter search over λ \lambda for both Point-MAE and DINOv2 took approximately 100 additional hours on an A100 GPU. However, the full research project required more resources, including additional configurations that did not make it into the paper and testing other properties of those models, such as different variants of alignment heads.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都运行在“为匿名而编辑的”计算组上。 所有实验都是在A100GPU上进行的. 每次训练耗时约5小时,每次检查站验证耗时约15分钟,既用于标准验证,也用于分配外验证. 仅使用图像编码器的实验,如补丁相似和t-SNE集群,在计算中可以忽略不计,每个任务耗时不到10分钟. 总而言之,主论文中使用的Point-MAE模型,基线模型和DINOv2模型以及主论文中的其他实验,在A100 GPU上用了约150小时. 超参数搜索在 Q\\ lambda 对 Point-MAE 和 DINov2 的搜索 在 A100 GPU 上又花了大约100个小时。 然而,全面研究项目需要更多的资源,包括没有将其纳入纸张的其他配置,并测试这些模型的其他特性,例如对齐头的不同变体。
